_readme: Round v6 (case C): one session, two SFTs from Gemma 3 270M. GPU 0 = v6w: common-word + probe teacher, guesses written as one lowercase word, plus a 40k spelling drill (boards built only around training-side words; targets may be any public dictionary word, disclosed). GPU 1 = v6: the same teacher in the v5 spaced format, no drill (fallback and ablation). Both scored on select and heldout, alone and with word-level decoding; the prompt format is read from the saved model. Compare with SFT v5 (select: 62.0% alone, 94.9% word-level).
